description: Downward Adjustment Factor (DAF) lookup, keyed by (host country, vintage year -> 5-year application window). A fixed coefficient within a window. Values from the 457 DAF tool Annex 01 (Applicable DAF, 2026-2030 window). See CALCULATOR_SPEC §3.4.

absolute_floor.desc: 1.25% global fallback — applied when no comparison group can be established.

sector_carveout_floor.desc: These sectors take the 1.25% absolute floor by default. (SDWS is none of these — informational.)

2031-2035.note: Next NDC-cycle update, not yet published (457 §6.3.1a).

transitional_rule: Projects registered before 2026 apply the 2026-2030 DAF from the 2026 vintage (457 §6.2.2).
notes: Applicable DAF read from 457 Annex 01 — the value immediately preceding the basis label (= the country DAF, or the peer-group ambition floor, whichever the tool selected).
The full ~190-country table lives in 457 Annex 01; only the golden-matrix anchor countries are pinned here for M3. Expand as scenarios need.
DAF is a fixed coefficient applied to every vintage year within the window (457 §6.1.1, §6.3.1a); select the row by host country and the window containing the crediting vintage.
